• PANTRY STAPLE: Bake up feel-good recipes with flavorful whole wheat flour

  • THE COMPLETE KERNEL: Milled from complete wheat kernels; Enhance the flavor of your recipes with this hearty and satisfying flour

  • CRUST TO CRUMB: Enjoy baked goods with chewy texture and wheaty flavor

  • FEEDING SOURDOUGH: Whole wheat flour's added nutrients and complex carbohydrates feed your sourdough starter, fostering robust growth and a tangy flavor

  • CONTAINS: One 5 lb bag of Gold Medal Premium Quality All Natural Whole Wheat Flour
features:
Features

Made from complete wheat kernels: Milled with the bran, germ, and endosperm, delivering full whole‑grain nutrition.

Hearty taste and texture: Adds a satisfying chew, deeper color, and robust wheaty flavor to your baking.

Versatile pantry staple: Suitable for quick breads, muffins, pizza dough, yeast loaves, and more—ideal for substituting whole wheat for all-purpose flour.

Feeds sourdough starters: Nutrient-rich carbohydrates in the flour help sourdough starters grow stronger and develop tangy flavor.

Simple ingredient list: Contains only whole wheat flour with no added preservatives or bleaches.

Trusted brand: Backed by Gold Medal’s 135+ years of milling expertise. 

Benefits

Boosts nutritional value: High in dietary fiber (3 g per ¼ cup, ~11% DV) and a source of plant-based protein (4 g per serving).

Supports heart and metabolic health: Regular whole grain consumption is linked to lower risk of heart disease, diabetes, and improved blood sugar regulation.

Enhances flavor and texture: Whole grain character transforms ordinary recipes into more flavorful and wholesome versions.

Easy adaptation for baking: Gradually replace all-purpose flour with whole wheat in recipes—no special equipment needed.

Excellent for home and artisan baking: Strong enough for high-rise breads, yet mild enough for pie crusts and baked goods.

Economical and convenient: A 5 lb bag provides ample flour for daily baking and is a budget-friendly choice.
